{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data to ensure we have the correct column names
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline and biomarker_final
print('Sentinel values in biomarker_baseline:', trial_df['biomarker_baseline'].unique())
print('Sentinel values in biomarker_final:', trial_df['biomarker_final'].unique())

# Identify rows with sentinel values (e.g., -999)
sentinel_mask = (trial_df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999) | (trial_df['biomarker_final'] == -999)
print('Number of rows with sentinel values:', sentinel_mask.sum())

# Remove rows with sentinel values
trial_df_clean = trial_df[~sentinel_mask]

# Recompute change in biomarker and response rate
trial_df_clean['biomarker_change'] = trial_df_clean['biomarker_final'] - trial_df_clean['biomarker_baseline']

biomarker_change_by_arm_clean = trial_df_clean.groupby('arm')['biomarker_change'].agg(['mean', 'std', 'count'])
response_rate_by_arm_clean = trial_df_clean.groupby('arm')['responded'].mean()

print('\nChange in biomarker by arm (after removing sentinel values):\n', biomarker_change_by_arm_clean)
print('\nResponse rate by arm (after removing sentinel values):\n', response_rate_by_arm_clean)"}
